components: a central descent with a right shoulder
a broad outer bowl returning up the left
strokeOrder: start inside the compact left body and curve down into its inner turn
without lifting, circle around the left inner loop and return toward its upper-left edge — then lift once
set the pen at the left end of the long top bar and carry it straight to the right — then lift a second time
set the pen at the upper-right shoulder and curve left toward the central upright
without lifting, descend the central upright to its lower end — then lift a third time
set the pen on the upper-right side and sweep around the broad outer-right curve
without lifting, continue around the bottom bowl toward the far left
without lifting, return up the outer-left side and finish below the top bar
strokeOrderNote: four strokes — movements 1–2 form the left inner loop, movement 3 is the detached top bar, movements 4–5 form the shoulder and central descent, and movements 6–8 form the broad outer bowl; cited to Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I, Frame 8, ஞ

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 8, ஞ (University of Texas at Austin), p. 194
strokeOrderSource.variation: Appendix I Frame 8 numbers eight movements: 1–2 build the left inner loop, 3 draws the top bar, 4–5 form the shoulder and central descent, and 6–8 sweep around the broad outer bowl. Tamil handwriting varies by school; this is one attested four-run order fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Tamil outline.

notes: Ña is the palatal nasal heard in combinations such as ஞ்ச. Frame 8's eight numbered movements resolve into four pen-down runs in this font fit: inner loop, top bar, central shoulder-and-descent, and outer bowl.
